scope: Independent public trust-root validation from pinned Git objects. No private material read, no license token generated, no network, package install, repository write or publication.

runtimeImplication.verifyLicense: Imports the authority before signature verification; catch returns {valid:false} when import fails
runtimeImplication.activation: activateLicense requires successful local verifyLicense before optional server activation
runtimeImplication.acceptance: licenseRequired:true is only an enabled gate flag; it does not prove an importable issuer or successful license activation

finding: The identical default public point is valid on NIST P-256 at baseline and current source. Both Node key construction and WebCrypto verify-key import accept it. This independently contradicts the reported ERR_CRYPTO_INVALID_JWK diagnosis for these exact source bytes; possession of a matching private issuer and successful activation remain separate unproven claims.
